schema_observed: Note/CC; absolute7Bit/relativeTwosComplement/noteGate; base/amber/green layers; red/amber/green colors; global channel plus contextual overrides. High-resolution pairs, arbitrary banks, independent per-binding channels, RGB palettes, non-twos-complement encoders and SysEx need adaptation or exclusion.
